description.value: Lakeview Inns & Suites – Fort Nelson is a mid-scale hotel on the Alaska Highway corridor in Fort Nelson, BC, part of the Lakeview Hotels and Resorts group. It holds a Green Key Eco-Rating and offers complimentary breakfast, making it a practical overnight stop for long-distance cycle tourists traversing northern BC. Fort Nelson sits near the start of the Alaska Highway's most remote stretch, so this is one of relatively few established accommodation options in the area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is real, open, and matches OSM contact details: address 4507 50th Avenue S, Fort Nelson, BC V0C 1R0 and phone +1 250 233 5001 both corroborate OSM. A guest review embedded on the site references 'free breakfast in the lobby with a variety of options,' but the fetched content is truncated before any full amenities list, and no cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, e-bike charging, Wi-Fi) are explicitly described in the available text.
